description: Source code for AgentService class and related models implementing an AI agent with tools for file operations, time retrieval, and calculations, including error handling and message parsing.

classes.name: AgentService
classes.description: Main class managing AI agent interactions, tools, and message flow.

methods.name: runAgent
methods.description: Executes the agent process asynchronously, handling message exchange, action execution, and error management.

methods.name: addStep
methods.description: Adds a new step to the agent's steps list with timestamp.

methods.name: setupTools
methods.description: Initializes available tools for file operations, time retrieval, and calculations.

methods.name: executeAction
methods.description: Parses and executes a specified action using available tools.

methods.name: parseAction
methods.description: Parses action string into tool name and arguments.

methods.name: parseArguments
methods.description: Parses a string of arguments into a list, handling quotes and commas.

methods.name: extractContent
methods.description: Helper to extract tagged content from message.

methods.name: generateSystemPrompt
methods.description: Creates the system prompt string including available tools and environment info.
